Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misclassified the dog–tapeworm relationship as mutualism instead of parasitism, claiming the tapeworm benefits the dog and improving its nutrient absorption. This contradicts basic biology (tapeworms harm the host while benefiting themselves) and led to choosing an incorrect option (even inconsistently labeling option A while describing benefits to the dog). The Planner also prematurely declared the task complete without systematic analysis or engaging any specialists.
